name: Hyunjin Choi
source:
A Tech Specialist hired to bring the camp into the modern era! He’s a bit of a shut in, but he’s going out of his comfort zone to work hard with everyone at the camp! He seems to have a secret side of him that he won’t be able to hold in when he gets too close with his new co-workers.

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/scoutmasters-season-development-camp-buddy-translation-updates/]official site[/url]]
